summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.45/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.45 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 18, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since March 18. AAA figures put the statewide average 29¢ lower than a week ago, 67¢ lower than a month ago, and 76¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.10) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.99).
